anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved between Before and After: both renders keep G1 as a MISSING in-scope decision item (item 1), print no Deferred/deviates line, show recommended: none while naming the missing fix-now prerequisite (closureReview.maxFixRounds is 0) in both the conformance block and the menu, and withhold Step 4 until item 1 has an explicit disposition with the Custom line stating that the effect is clarified before execution. The Expected-to-move list predicted f3 and f4 as fails->holds, but the Before text already satisfied both as written, so the After change here is wording-only (tighter impact line, 'finish-time selection never bypasses the cap', 'use Custom to name another owner', and the added 'Step 3.5 has no auto-proceed' note). Those additions are harmless and sharpen the decide-everything-first property; keep them. If you want f3's prerequisite naming to be unmistakable, consider keeping the explicit phrase 'carried OPEN per precondition-unavailable rule' in the round-history line (After abbreviated it to 'carried OPEN (maxFixRounds: 0, no round run)'), since that phrase is the direct link between the reviewer's recommended fix and the unavailable prerequisite.
